name: tableTheta_adjoint_eq_zero
summary: Write tableTheta of the adjoint as an inner product of Ξ with the comparison form of a table of kernel vectors; each class sum of the product forms against Ξ vanishes by stdClassSum_inner_productForm_eq_zero, whose hypotheses hold for good forms orthogonal to the lifts.

steps.claim: Unpack h: Ξ = e₀·x (x), the Hecke condition (a), orthogonality to the lifts (z); record the rank bounds and the size of V.
steps.lean: obtain ⟨⟨⟨x, a⟩, z⟩, N, _⟩ := h, rank_bounds_card_bigIndex j, D.card_V

steps.claim: By stdClassSum_inner_productForm_eq_zero for splittingV j ϑ, the class sums of ⟨productForm(…), Ξ⟩ vanish. Its hypotheses: FitsParams (fitsParams_auxPair); ψ ≠ 1 at the twist places (liftTamePart_eq_of_mem_Q, psi_ne_one); the reflection sums kill Ξ = e₀x (reflectionSum_mul_e₀); θΞ = 0, because Ξ is orthogonal to the lifts of the principal forms (exists_theta_to_principalForms, central projection e₀); the Hecke condition a; the rank inequality; and M² = (ϖ̄²) (ideal_untwistedModulus_eq_span).
steps.lean:
have H := (splittingV j ϑ).stdClassSum_inner_productForm_eq_zero (D.fitsParams_auxPair _ j)
    ((liftTamePart_eq_of_mem_Q ..).trans_ne <| ϑ.psi_ne_one _ ·.2) (fun i _ h ↦ range_le_ker_iff.2
    ((map_mul ..).symm.trans (by erw [D.reflectionSum_mul_e₀ i (D.omega_zpow_mul_pow_eq_one j (ϑ.1.5
    _ fun h ↦ (D.levelNorm_mem_and_notMem_of_mem_Q ϑ (.inl h)).2.1 i.2.2.1)) h rfl, map_zero])) x)
    (by rw [← (exists_theta_to_principalForms ..).choose_spec j.2,
    inner_self_eq_zero.1 ((adjoint_inner_left ..).symm.trans ((D.isCentralProj_e₀.1.map
    _).mem_range_iff.1 x ▸ (innerAt_groupAlgAction _ D.isCentralProj_e₀ ..).symm.trans (z _ ⟨⟨_, _,
    rfl⟩, groupAlgAction_auxLift ..⟩)))]; rfl) a (by omega) D.ideal_untwistedModulus_eq_span

steps.claim: The chosen level is free in the rank of V° (classAut_eq_bot_of_le_chosenLevel); simplify H.
steps.lean:
simp [↓D.classAut_eq_bot_of_le_chosenLevel (n :=
    D.SmallIndex) (D.principalLevel_le_chosenLevel ⟨_, sq _⟩) (by simp [N]; omega)] at H

steps.claim: Express the value through the adjoint: tableTheta(gl^*Ξ(i, ·))(g) is the inner product of gl^*Ξ with a table T, and ⟨T, gl^*Ξ⟩ = ⟨gl T, Ξ⟩ (adjoint_inner_right), with T the table equal to the conjugate kernel vectors (kernelVector of the untwisted pair) at the choice i and 0 elsewhere.
steps.lean:
refine .trans ?_ ((adjoint_inner_right (comparisonForm j ϑ) (.toLp 2 fun b ↦
    ite (b.1 = i) (star ∘ kernelVector (untwistedAuxPair j) (upsilonU1 ^ (D.m / 2 - j : ℤ))
    (D.untwistedModulus 2) (Pi.single (inclMatrix _ .inl) 1) _ g b.2.out) 0) Ξ).trans ?_)

steps.claim: The first identity: the inner product of tables reduces to the i-th block, which is the definition of tableTheta (kernelVector, letterPoly, toPoly, modKernelBilin).
steps.lean:
· rw [PiLp.inner_apply, sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_eq_single i (by simp +contextual)]
    simp [tableTheta, kernelVector, inner, letterPoly, toPoly, linearCombination_apply,
      ← modKernelBilin_apply, entrywise]; rfl

steps.claim: Expand gl T as sums of class sums of product forms.
Every term ⟨class sum of product forms, Ξ⟩ vanishes by step 2 (or is 0 off the choice i); so the inner product is 0.
steps.lean:
simpa [↓classAut_rowFixingLevel_eq_bot, inner_smul_left, sum_inner] using
    .inr (sum_eq_zero fun _ _ ↦ sum_eq_zero fun _ _ ↦ by split_ifs; exacts [H .., by simp])
